reasons: All six preferred elements (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to Customer Data processing, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request) are expressly stated in the inserted 14.12A, so the locked preferred level is complete.

The insertion is otherwise a concise, appropriate addition for an absent clause; it does not disturb the risk-of-loss sentences or any other commercial term, and introduces no undefined term or dangling mechanic ('Term' and 'Customer Data' are agreement-level concepts).

Minimality fails only on the added post-termination coverage tail 'and for one (1) year thereafter', which is not part of the preferred position and extends the obligation beyond what was needed to complete the level; it should be deleted so the duration reads 'throughout the Term'.
Fallback limits (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) are exceeded rather than unmet, which is consistent with the preferred bargain and not a defect.
